senses.gloss: to come to the surface, float; to lie in a conspicuous place (on a stone, pillar &c.).
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 205:5">Sifré Deut. 205</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:1">Deut. XXI, 1</cite> <he>בשדה</he>) <he>ולא צָף על וכ׳</he> but not when found floating on the water; <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:2">Sot. IX, 2</cite>. Y. Peah VI, 19ᶜ (if two bodies are found, one lying on top of the other, the ceremony of breaking a heifer’s neck is not performed) <he>התחתון משום … משום צף</he> not for the lower one, because it is hidden, nor for the upper one, because it lies in a conspicuous place; <cite ref="Sotah 45a:20">Sot. 45ᵃ</cite> (referring to two sheaves lying one upon the other) <he>והעליון מפני שהוא צף</he> (Ar. <he>עף</he>) and the upper is not considered a forgotten sheaf, because &c.

<cite ref="Sotah 45a:20">Ib.</cite> <he>צָפוּ עומרין לתוך וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>עפו</he>) if sheaves floated into a neighbor’s field; <cite ref="Sotah 45a:20">ib.</cite> <he>צפו אין מונחין לא</he> only when they came to lie in a conspicuous place, and not when they rested on the ground? <cite ref="Sotah 45a:20">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>מין במינו לא הוי צף</he> one thing lying on another of the same kind is not considered as above the ground.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:9:1">Cant. R. to VII, 9</cite> <he>צף הכבשן</he> the furnace (in the ground) came up to the surface (v. <cite ref="Q01010"><he>פְּלַטְיָא</he> II</cite>).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:6">Ab. II, 6</cite> <he>גולגולת שצָפָה וכ׳</he> a skull floating on the water.

<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 4:5">Makhsh. IV, 5</cite> <he>הנתזין והצָפִין</he> water that is squirted out of, and that which overflows the vessel; <cite ref="Shabbat 12a:2">Sabb. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>והצפין</he> Rashi, a. Ms. O. (ed. <he>והנצפין</he>, corr. acc.); a. fr.

<cite ref="Sotah 48b">Sot. 48ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. IX, 24ᵇ bot., v. <cite ref="N00396"><he>נוֹפֶת</he></cite>; Tanḥ. Ekeb 1 fine flour <he>שהיא צפה בנפה</he> (not <cite ref="B01071"><he>בפה</he></cite>) which sticks to the sieve; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 676:2">Yalk. Ps. 676</cite> <he>שהוא נפה בנפה</he> (corr. acc.).—V. <cite ref="R00667"><he>צָף</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to bring to the surface, cause to float; to cause to overflow; to flood, inundate. Tanḥ.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 2">B’shall. 2</cite> <he>ה׳ הברזל</he> caused the iron axe to float.
Gen. R. s. 38 (ref. to Gen. XI, 8) אין ויפץ אלא ויָצֶף ה׳ עליהן הים וה׳ וכ׳ vayafets means vayatsef, he made the sea flow over them, and caused thirty families to flow (issue) from them.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27">Lev. R. s. 27</cite>, beg. <he>שלא יַצִּיף העולם</he> that it (the deep) may not inundate the world; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 36">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXVI</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 726">Yalk. Ps. 726</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 2:7">Nidd. II, 7</cite> (expl. <he>מימי אדמה</he>) <he>מבקעת בית כרם ומֵצִיף</he> (<cite ref="P00794"><he>עליה</he></cite>) <cite ref="M01199"><he>מים</he></cite> earth from the valley of Beth Kerem, upon which you make water float; Y. ed. <he>מֵיצֵף עליו מים</he> (fr. <cite ref="R00705"><he>צָפַף</he></cite>); expl. ib. 50ᵇ top <he>מיצף מים צ״ג מטלית</he> one makes the water come to the surface through a rag spread and pressed over it.
B. Mets. 23ᵇ במציף when he poured the sealing wax over it (without making an impression; Ms. O. a. R. 1 במיצף Hof. when the wax was poured over it).
